scenes.setting: Alone in Morse Cathedral with 3-0782: the dualistic ritual siphons the divine blood — heat rises as Klein carves the Flaring Sun Charms
scenes.text_anchor: Weak light shone through the narrow window from high above

scenes.setting: Outside the cathedral: the sunlight blazes like early July for a few minutes; Leonard eyes the church with knitted brows
scenes.text_anchor: Outside the church, Leonard was standing in the shadows

scenes.setting: Cathedral: two finished Flaring Sun Charms pocketed, activation word 'light'; a drenched Klein hands the artifact to a quietly suspicious Leonard
scenes.text_anchor: In the cathedral, Klein's carving knife finished the final stroke.

scenes.setting: The ride back to Tingen and the artifact's return — the Captain notices nothing unusual
scenes.text_anchor: After the shifts ended, the three Nighthawks began their journey back.

scenes.setting: Home before eight: the new maidservant Bella — a Goddess-believing factory worker's daughter — scrubs the dining hall on trial
scenes.text_anchor: He took out his keys and opened the door, only to see an unknown figure.

scenes.setting: Blackthorn reception: Old Neil is sick — a noon visit is planned; Rozanne is stunned to learn he was ever married
scenes.text_anchor: The next day, Klein entered the Blackthorn Security Company in a good mood.
